name: The Serpent
source: A mysterious and ancient supernatural entity, The Serpent is tied to Lind’s forgotten history. It is a buried evil that has waited patiently beneath the town’s surface. Its presence is marked by a mysterious bracelet, drawing in those vulnerable to its whispering promises. What it truly is and what it seeks remain unclear, but one thing is certain: it is the force that found its way into Ben Clarke’s heart, twisting his desires and unleashing the darkness now spreading across Lind.
